name: selfEmployeeLeaveApplication
description: For self leave queries (my, self, apply leave, check my, me), first call selfEmployeeLeaveBalance to fetch available balances. When the user picks a leave type, take leaveTypeCode and leaveGroupCode from that response; never ask for or show these codes. If a covering employee is specified, allow search by name/code and resolve EmployeeNumber using getEmpDetails API. Always ask for a leave comment/reason. After identifying the leave type, check IsCommentMandatory from the selected leave type API response: if 1 a comment is required and must not be skipped; if 0 it is optional. Never hardcode this - it varies by client and leave type. Check IsAttachmentRequired too: if 1, set isAttachmentMandatory true and ask the user to attach the document - the tool uploads any file attached to the chat. The tool previews first: show that preview to the user, then call again with confirmed:true only once they agree. Show only user-friendly names and hide all internal codes throughout the flow.

args.name: leaveTypeCode
args.description: to get the leave type is "selfEmployeeLeaveBalance" api. user give leave type name corresponding leave Type Code will be Example:"000001", do not ask the user for leave type code.

args.name: fromDate
args.description: user to give the leave from date. Example:"09/04/24" - must should take in this date format "dd/mm/yy"

args.name: toDate

args.name: coveringEmployeeCode
args.description: in this argument is optional field but if the user added the covering employee to search employee name or code if the user search name corresponding id take Ex:"000002" for execute api is getCoveringEmployee Api.

args.name: year
args.description: user provide the year example 2025,2024 etc.

args.name: dayMode
args.description: if the user to ask leave mode like Whole Day means 1 ,First Half means 0.5, Second Half means 0.5 and Off Day means 0.0 user selected leave mode name corresponding value will be take, and display the names, no display the values.
